description: This file defines a custom exception class LoanTransactionProcessingStrategyNotFoundException for the Fineract project. It extends an abstract exception and represents cases where a loan transaction processing strategy resource cannot be found by code.

classes.name: LoanTransactionProcessingStrategyNotFoundException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating that a specific loan transaction processing strategy resource was not found, identified by a code.

methods.name: LoanTransactionProcessingStrategyNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error code and a message indicating the missing resource.
